name: Dr. T (Anthony Cahill)
reason: His work (Total kNowledge Technique, now Angelic Heart Healing, plus remote healing sessions and a supplements shop) is sold on healing the body: his pages promise 'rapid healing', a framework for 'the most urgent and common emotional and health issues' and help with 'adverse physical and emotional conditions', so almost nothing passes the health-claim rule; his one Omega workshop (11 Oct 2026) has also passed. Full name taken from the Omega headshot file name ('Anthony_Dr T_Cahill'); his own site gives only 'Dr. T'.
